week_thesis: Markets entered October at all-time highs (~S&P 7,750) but with deteriorating breadth and rising bond yields. Rotating out of LLY (underperforming SPY on RS60, RSI 70.3, negative technical score) and DD (not in universe, weakest portfolio performer) into MU (Micron), which has dipped ~32% from its June $1,200 peak to $820, with RSI 34.7 signaling oversold conditions. Micron's HBM memory is sold out for 2026, fiscal Q3 revenue +346% YoY, and Mizuho rates Outperform with $1,375 target. AMD skipped despite #1 score due to earnings Nov 3 and +5% 5-day run (anti-chase). Holding AMAT and NVDA as core AI/semiconductor infrastructure positions.
